entities.name: Gideon Jura

events.summary: Aurelia replaces Feather as leader of the Boros.
events.quote: Aurelia ascended to the leadership of the Boros

events.summary: Aurelia asks Gideon to cleanse the Ninth District and invites him to join the Legion.
events.quote: she asked him to cleanse the Ninth District of Ravnica, inviting him to join the Legion

events.summary: Aurelia attends the guild summit and sees it dissolve after Isperia's murder, then joins Ral's alliance.
events.quote: She witnessed its dissolution after the murder of Isperia

events.summary: Aurelia is a general against the Dreadhorde and represents the Boros at Niv-Mizzet's resurrection.
events.quote: Aurelia was one of the generals of the forces fighting Bolas 's Dreadhorde
displayed much sorrow over Gideon's death

events.summary: Aurelia meets the Phyrexian invasion head-on.
events.quote: Aurelia met the Phyrexian invasion head-on

events.summary: At Karlov Manor Zegana is assassinated and Massacre Girl attempts Aurelia's life; Kaya, Kellan and Agrus Kos win time to investigate.
events.quote: an attempt was made on her own life by Massacre Girl

events.summary: Alquist Proft reveals Oba organized the murders; Oba captures Aurelia, freed when Kaya and Etrata defeat her; Aurelia arrests Krenko.
events.quote: Aurelia was captured, but was freed after Kaya and Etrata defeated Oba

events.summary: Aurelia tries to arrest Ral, Kaya and Vraska; Vraska challenges and assassinates her.
events.quote: The assassination was confirmed successful in a later issue

relations.quote: Aurelia is the current guildmaster of the Boros Legion on Ravnica

relations.note: worked closely together in the War

relations.quote: When Oba attacked the guild leaders, Aurelia was captured
challenged Aurelia to a death match
